name_reason: Follows fd2_<domain>_<descriptor>: domain 'dialog' (decodes the dialog-pixel run-length encoded stream via fd2_decode_dialog_pixel_byte), descriptor 'sprite_blit_normal' where 'normal' (left-to-right STOSB) is the meaningful contrast to the 'mirrored' sister fd2_dialog_sprite_blit_mirrored @ 0x4E8E1 (DEC EDI). No address residue. Accurately reflects the opaque (writes every pixel, no transparency skip) per-pixel dialog/UI sprite painter.
purpose: Opaque rectangular-sprite painter for the dialog-pixel encoded stream: decodes each row left-to-right and writes EVERY pixel (including zero) to dst with no transparency skip.
logic_summary: Reads width (header word0) and row_count (header word1); cursor = header+4. Seeds decode state to 0 once. Outer do/while runs row_count rows; inner do/while runs exactly width pixels per row, each pixel = low byte of fd2_decode_dialog_pixel_byte(state,&cursor) with state threaded across calls (and across rows, so runs straddle row boundaries) and cursor advanced 0/1/2 bytes per call (LODSB model). Each decoded byte is stored unconditionally (STOSB) and dst_row advances +1; after each row dst += stride. Binary wraps body in PUSHAD/POPAD and ends plain RET (cdecl); EAX is preserved so the decompiler 'return in_EAX' is a passthrough artifact (callers discard -> void). The decompiler's inner 'while (extraout_ECX != 1)' is a phantom: the inner loop is a fixed width-count LOOP (CX seeded from BP=width, ECX pre-zeroed) and the decoder never touches ECX. Both counters are 16-bit down-counters that wrap on a zero header word.
signature: void fd2_dialog_sprite_blit_normal(uint32 dst, uint32 sprite_hdr, uint32 stride)

params.name: dst
params.semantics: Destination base linear address (row base of the first row); arrives in EDI ([EBP+8]). Advanced by stride each row.

params.name: sprite_hdr
params.semantics: Sprite header pointer; ushort width at +0, ushort row_count at +2, encoded pixel byte stream from +4. Arrives in ESI ([EBP+0xC]).
params.reason: Accurate, matches the header-pointer convention used across the blit family; no address residue.

params.name: stride
params.semantics: Bytes to advance dst per destination row. Arrives in EBX ([EBP+0x10]).

returns.semantics: No meaningful return. Binary preserves EAX through PUSHAD/POPAD and does a plain RET; the decompiler's 'return in_EAX' is a passthrough artifact and all 36 call sites discard it.
